capabilities: insert an sp-bar code block to track section progress
display a note-wide progress bar in the note header
count checkboxes within a heading section
update the bar in real time as checkboxes change
label embedded bars from selected text or custom text
extras: Known issue: freshly edited sp-bar code blocks may not re-render until switching notes or toggling reading/source mode; further troubleshooting is in a separate TROUBLESHOOTING.md file.
problem: Obsidian's Task lists feature does not visualize completion progress for the checkboxes in a note or heading section.
summary: Progress bar plugin that tracks checkbox completion, showing a note-wide bar in the header and embedded per-section bars via sp-bar code blocks.
